svg.aria-label: The same student attempt graded by a bigger model, by the same model with an answer key, or with the error text.
svg.text: It has to exist before you start.
a stronger model to query on every step
a verified solution for every problem
feedback text, or one successful attempt in the group
The student always writes the attempt and sees only x at test time. What changes is who grades it, and what that grader is shown.
